facts.statement: The known fossils of Agnosphitys consist of an ilium, maxilla, astragalus, and humerus.
facts.quote: Its remains include an ilium, maxilla, astragalus and humerus

facts.statement: The species Agnosphitys cromhallensis was described by Nicholas Fraser, Kevin Padian, Gordon Walkden, and A. L. M. Davis in early 2002.
facts.quote: The type species, Agnosphitys cromhallensis, was described by Nicholas Fraser, Kevin Padian, Gordon Walkden and A. L. M Davis in early 2002

facts.statement: Fossils of Agnosphitys consist of two distinct specimens.
facts.quote: The fossils consist of two specimens

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is a single isolated left ilium.
facts.quote: The holotype consists of a single isolated left ilium

facts.statement: The fossils were found in the Magnesian Conglomerate of Avon, England.
facts.quote: were found in the Magnesian Conglomerate of Avon, England

facts.statement: The genus Agnosphitys contains only one known species, A. cromhallensis.
facts.quote: It contains only one species, the type species A. cromhallensis

facts.statement: The fossils date from the Norian and Rhaetian stages of the Late Triassic, or possibly the Hettangian stage of the Early Jurassic.
facts.quote: Its remains include an ilium, maxilla, astragalus and humerus, which date variously from the Norian and Rhaetian stages of the Late Triassic, or possibly as late as the Hettangian stage of the Early Jurassic

facts.statement: In its original description, Agnosphitys was placed outside Dinosauria based on the definition provided by Padian and May (1995).
facts.quote: the describers placed it outside Dinosauria using the definition of Dinosauria outlined by Padian and May (1995)

facts.statement: A 2007 phylogenetic analysis by Yates recovered Agnosphitys as a theropod.
facts.quote: Yates (2007) recovered the genus as a theropod

facts.statement: A 2010 analysis by Ezcurra recovered Agnosphitys as a member of the family Guaibasauridae.
facts.quote: Ezcurra (2010) recovered it as a member of Guaibasauridae

facts.statement: Recent studies have considered Agnosphitys to be a silesaurid based on unpublished descriptions of Asilisaurus.
facts.quote: More recently, Agnosphitys has been considered a silesaurid based on an as-yet-unpublished description of Asilisaurus

facts.statement: A 2017 large-scale phylogenetic analysis by Baron, Norman, and Barrett recovered Agnosphitys as a member of the clade Silesauridae.
facts.quote: A large phylogenetic analysis of early dinosaurs and dinosauromorphs carried out by Matthew Baron, David Norman and Paul Barrett (2017) recovered Agnosphitys as a member of the clade Silesauridae

facts.statement: Agnosphitys lived during the Late Triassic, approximately 218 million years ago in the Norian stage, in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Triásico, hace aproximadamente 218 millones de años, en el Noriense, en lo que hoy es Europa

facts.statement: Based on the left ilium discovered in 1990, scientists estimate Agnosphitys measured approximately 70 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: Los científicos, basados en el ilion izquierdo, descubierto en 1990, creen que pudo medir aproximadamente 70 centímetros de longitud

facts.statement: According to its describers, Agnosphitys exhibited 5 of the 17 potential synapomorphies accepted for dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Según los autores de la descripción, Agnosphitys exhibía 5 de las 17 sinapomorfias potenciales aceptadas en los dinosaurios

facts.statement: While Agnosphitys is considered close to the ancestor of dinosaurs, its exact evolutionary position is disputed by researchers.
facts.quote: Agnosphitys es cercano al ancestro de los dinosaurios, aunque su lugar exacto es disputado por investigadores

facts.statement: Researchers disagree on whether Agnosphitys is a theropod dinosaur more derived than Eoraptor or a dinosauromorph archosaur closely related to dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Unos lo consideran un dinosaurio terópodo que estuvo cerca de los principios de la evolución de los dinosaurios pero más derivado que Eoraptor, mientras que otros lo consideran un arcosaurio dinosauromórfo, con mucho parentesco a los dinosaurios

facts.statement: In 2007, José Fernando Bonaparte and colleagues included Agnosphitys in the primitive saurischian family Guaibasauridae.
facts.quote: En 2007 José Fernando Bonaparte y colaboradores, lo incluyeron en la familia de saurisquios primitivos Guaibasauridae

facts.statement: The time range for Agnosphitys is estimated from 237 to 227.3 million years ago during the Carnian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Carnian (237 to 227.3 million years ago)

rejected.statement: The second specimen is a partial skeleton that includes a left maxilla, a humerus, and a left astragalus.
rejected.quote: the second specimen consists of a partial skeleton including a left maxilla, a humerus and a left astragalus
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'a left maxilla a humerus and a left'
